newsitem.title: USA: St. Mary sees projects lifting output 10-20 pct.
newsitem.headline: St. Mary sees projects lifting output 10-20 pct.

text.p: St. Mary Land & Exploration Co said it expects to see an increase in hydrocarbon production of 10 to 20 percent in the next three to six months from ongoing projects.

"Our ongoing drilling program and recent acquisitions, combined with steady progress in developing our portfolio of larger target projects, position St. Mary for continued growth in 1997," St. Mary president and chief executive Mark Hellerstein said in a statement.

Average daily domestic oil and gas production during the quarter was 11,018 barrels of oil equivalent, a 10 percent increase over the second quarter of 1996 and a 37 percent increase over the third quarter one year ago, the firm said. Earlier, St. Mary said third quarter earnings were $3,074,000 or $0.35 per share versus $117,000 or $0.01 cent in the comparable 1995 quarter.
